name: Bridge Securities Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1994, Bridge Securities Ltd is in the business of getting commission from agriculture activities[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
BSL is in trading of products like seeds, agricultural produces mainly Rice, Wheat, Onions, Potato, Tomato, Isabgol, and Pulses. It sources the agricultural products from manufacturers by paying an advance payment with own labeling and sells them to its network of distributors. It also does contract manufacturing, wherein it leases an agricultural land on lease and cultivate Cucumber, Onion and Castor

pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 32.6%
Debtor days have improved from 75.4 to 22.9 days.
cons: Stock is trading at 11.8 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 4.13% over past five years.
Working capital days have increased from 300 days to 495 days
